why: Four rules in one pair, because they are one mistake wearing four hats. The steps are flexbox divs inside a ul (list), stray li elements sit in a div rather than a list (listitem), the label/value block is spans inside a dl (definition-list), and a dt/dd pair floats free of any dl (dlitem). The after uses the elements whose job this is, and keeps role="list" on the marker-less list so Safari does not drop the semantics.
